violated_contract: A request-bound signature must be verified against the same encoded path representation that its issuer authenticated. Comparing a Worker URL.pathname signature with an ASGI percent-decoded routing path rejects legitimate requests containing encoded identifiers and conflates routing representation with authentication identity.
canonical_prevention: Use one shared raw-path extractor for all Python assertion consumers. Verify exact encoded pathname bytes; reject absent or malformed raw paths. Exercise production middleware with encoded IDs, Unicode, double encoding, representation changes and existing plain-path clients.
